verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies that customizable fields exist. First-party docs mention board columns as a first-class concept (change_column_value events, column menus) and custom board and item views. Community users describe monday as heavily un-opinionated and needing lots of setup and customization. No doc explicitly describes defining custom fields or editing workflow status labels to match a team process. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom field/column type creation, configurable workflow status labels and transitions, and hands-on corroboration of tailoring statuses to a team process.
